L908: /*
L909: 
L910: Compile, typically invoked as ``go tool compile,'' compiles a single Go package
L911: 
L912: comprising the files named on the command line. It then writes a single
L913: 
L914: object file named for the basename of the first source file with a .o suffix.
L915: 
L916: The object file can then be combined with other objects into a package archive
L917: 
L918: or passed directly to the linker (``go tool link''). If invoked with -pack, the compiler
L919: writes an archive directly, bypassing the intermediate object file.
L920: 
L921: The generated files contain type information about the symbols exported by
L922: 
L923: the package and about types used by symbols imported by the package from
L924: 
L925: other packages. It is therefore not necessary when compiling client C of
L926: 
L927: package P to read the files of P's dependencies, only the compiled output of P.
L928: # Command Line
L929: 
L930: Usage:
L931: 
L932: go tool compile [flags] file...
L933: 
L934: The specified files must be Go source files and all part of the same package.
L935: 
L936: The same compiler is used for all target operating systems and architectures.
L937: 
L938: The GOOS and GOARCH environment variables set the desired target.
L939: 
L940: Flags:
L941: 
L942: -D path
L943: 
L944: Set relative path for local imports.
L945: 
L946: -I dir1 -I dir2
L947: 
L948: Search for imported packages in dir1, dir2, etc,
L949: 
L950: after consulting $GOROOT/pkg/$GOOS_$GOARCH.
L951: 
L952: -L
L953: 
L954: Show complete file path in error messages.
L955: 
L956: -N
L957: Disable optimizations.
L958: 
L959: -S
L960: 
L961: Print assembly listing to standard output (code only).
L962: 
L963: -S -S
L964: 
L965: Print assembly listing to standard output (code and data).
L966: 
L967: -V
L968: 
L969: Print compiler version and exit.
L970: 
L971: -asmhdr file
L972: 
L973: Write assembly header to file.
L974: 
L975: -asan
L976: 
L977: Insert calls to C/C++ address sanitizer.
L978: 
L979: -buildid id
L980: 
L981: Record id as the build id in the export metadata.
L982: 
L983: -blockprofile file
L984: 
L985: Write block profile for the compilation to file.
L986: 
L987: -c int
L988: 
L989: Concurrency during compilation. Set 1 for no concurrency (default is 1).
L990: 
L991: -complete
L992: Assume package has no non-Go components.
L993: 
L994: -cpuprofile file
L995: 
L996: Write a CPU profile for the compilation to file.
L997: 
L998: -dynlink
L999: 
L1000: Allow references to Go symbols in shared libraries (experimental).
L1001: 
L1002: -e
L1003: 
L1004: Remove the limit on the number of errors reported (default limit is 10).
L1005: 
L1006: -embedcfg file
L1007: 
L1008: Read go:embed configuration from file.
L1009: 
L1010: This is required if any //go:embed directives are used.
L1011: 
L1012: The file is a JSON file mapping patterns to lists of filenames
L1013: 
L1014: and filenames to full path names.
L1015: 
L1016: -goversion string
L1017: Specify required go tool version of the runtime.
L1018: 
L1019: Exits when the runtime go version does not match goversion.
L1020: 
L1021: -h
L1022: 
L1023: Halt with a stack trace at the first error detected.
L1024: 
L1025: -importcfg file
L1026: 
L1027: Read import configuration from file.
L1028: 
L1029: In the file, set importmap, packagefile to specify import resolution.
L1030: 
L1031: -installsuffix suffix
L1032: 
L1033: Look for packages in $GOROOT/pkg/$GOOS_$GOARCH_suffix
L1034: 
L1035: instead of $GOROOT/pkg/$GOOS_$GOARCH.
L1036: 
L1037: -l
L1038: 
L1039: Disable inlining.
L1040: 
L1041: -lang version
L1042: 
L1043: Set language version to compile, as in -lang=go1.12.
L1044: Default is current version.
L1045: 
L1046: -linkobj file
L1047: 
L1048: Write linker-specific object to file and compiler-specific
L1049: 
L1050: object to usual output file (as specified by -o).
L1051: 
L1052: Without this flag, the -o output is a combination of both
L1053: 
L1054: linker and compiler input.
L1055: 
L1056: -m
L1057: 
L1058: Print optimization decisions. Higher values or repetition
L1059: 
L1060: produce more detail.
L1061: 
L1062: -memprofile file
L1063: 
L1064: Write memory profile for the compilation to file.
L1065: 
L1066: -memprofilerate rate
L1067: 
L1068: Set runtime.MemProfileRate for the compilation to rate.
L1069: 
L1070: -msan
L1071: Insert calls to C/C++ memory sanitizer.
L1072: 
L1073: -mutexprofile file
L1074: 
L1075: Write mutex profile for the compilation to file.
L1076: 
L1077: -nolocalimports
L1078: 
L1079: Disallow local (relative) imports.
L1080: 
L1081: -o file
L1082: 
L1083: Write object to file (default file.o or, with -pack, file.a).
L1084: 
L1085: -p path
L1086:
